description: This is a CMake configuration file for setting up cross-compilation toolchain variables, including system name, compiler flags, sysroot, and include paths. It also dynamically includes additional toolchain configuration scripts.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a CMake variable to a specified value, optionally forcing the override.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Defines a list of files matching a glob pattern.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes another CMake script into the current one.
